description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Teams' that manages the creation, listing, filtering, and deletion of teams within a user interface. It includes UI elements such as forms, tables, modals, and tabs to facilitate team management in a dashboard application, along with associated logic for handling data fetching, filtering, and user permissions.

methods.name: getOrganizationModels
methods.description: Determines the list of models available for the given organization, considering user models and wildcard models.

methods.name: canCreateOrManageTeams
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permissions to create or manage teams based on role and organization membership.

methods.name: getAdminOrganizations
methods.description: Returns the list of organizations where the user has admin privileges.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new team by submitting form data to the backend and updating the state.

methods.name: is_team_admin
methods.description: Determines if the current user has admin rights on a specific team.

methods.name: handleRefreshClick
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of the team list by updating the 'lastRefreshed' timestamp.

methods.name: handleFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filter parameters and refetches the filtered team data.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates sorting parameters and refetches sorted team data.

methods.name: handleFilterReset
methods.description: Resets all filters to default state and refetches the full team list.
